purpose: Requirements-to-acceptance design for customer review; technical tests are evidence of a slice, not signed SOW acceptance.
evidencePolicy: Each UAT run must record customer database, build hash, role, fixture/source IDs, expected/actual result, evidence location and reviewer. Never attach credentials. A partial technical test cannot close a broader requirement.

connectedWorkflowEngineeringEvidence.scope: Synthetic CRM/estimate-to-project, budget, subcontract SES, funded supplier advance/recovery/retention, native AP/AR posting and payments, posted labour/plant actuals, P6 intake, CVR, field/document evidence, scheduled snapshot and guarded final closure
connectedWorkflowEngineeringEvidence.limits: Does not close unrelated estimating/import, supplier scorecard, escalation, material-planning, asset/WIP or statutory reporting gaps; real vendor/identity/tax/hosting acceptance is external evidence, not a synthetic fixture.

gapScenarios.acceptance: Map customer-specific workbook columns to typed BOQ fields; preview unmapped/invalid rows; reject errors before committing; reconcile row counts, quantities and totals.
Compare two approved study versions; identify added/removed/changed lines using stable identities; reconcile quantities, rates and selling-value deltas; drill to both versions.
Apply agreed header/item markup to resource costs; verify exact rounding and the multiplicative basis; reconcile the approved quotation to the frozen estimate.
Import multiple independent BOQ workbooks in one reviewed batch; retain file/sheet/row provenance; reject duplicate source rows and reconcile totals per file and batch.
Suggest editable labour/material/equipment resource assemblies without auto-approval; retain suggestion provenance; recalculate and approve the final resource basis.
Show study-to-study cost, selling value and margin deltas; distinguish scope, quantity and rate changes; prohibit comparisons that silently mix currencies.
Run concurrent editors and concurrent submit/approve actions; detect conflicts; prevent a stale write from changing an approved snapshot; deny unauthorized fields/actions.
Reconstruct every approved BOQ revision and its actor/time/reason; prevent rewriting approved snapshots or deleting their audit evidence.
Collect supplier prices without creating a commitment or PO; compare revisions and validity dates; require explicit approval before a later commitment.
Preserve primary and secondary UOM with validated conversion; price on an explicit basis; reconcile consolidated BOQ totals; demonstrate supported handover or a clear blocked conversion.
Model eleven villas with one differing unit; reconcile each unit and the consolidated quantity/cost/selling totals; retain differences across study revisions.
Restructure and resequence BOQ hierarchy without losing stable identities, historical comparisons, WBS mapping or financial totals.
Extract an irregular workbook into a review queue; label uncertain mappings; require human validation; reject bad units/quantities/formulas and retain the original workbook.
Calculate agreed supplier scorecards by project/activity from linked delivery, service and quality evidence; drill into numerator/denominator records and respect permissions.
Display planned project activities and due actions on one filtered calendar; assign owners; retain updates and overdue follow-up without modifying the P6 master.
Start lifecycle at actual submission; distinguish draft creation from submission/review/completion; lock system dates and calculate completed turnaround consistently.
Trace a partial SES to subcontract, project/WBS, accepted quantity, invoice and remaining commitment; block acceptance beyond the contractual quantity.
Deliver and audit SES status notifications to the currently authorized responsible role; suppress duplicates on retries and prevent confidential content disclosure.
Map P6 project/WBS/activity/progress identifiers to ERP records; preserve the scheduling master and reject missing or cross-project mappings.
Upload the approved P6 template with row-level validation, clear errors and a reviewed import; malformed rows cannot partially create invalid business links.
Replay identical and revised P6 updates; avoid duplicates; reconcile additions/changes/deletions and produce an exception/reprocessing log.
Validate labour, material and plant availability for the requested dates/site before allocation; explain shortages and preserve override approval evidence.
Block overlapping/capacity-exceeding allocations across projects and shifts under concurrent requests; allow only an explicitly authorized, audited override.
Trace PR through RFQ/PO, partial receipts/SES, matched invoices and payment preparation; maintain project/WBS links and prevent duplicate documents during retries.
Show PR stage, pending approver role and stage age from actual transitions; approval is permission-checked and cannot exceed the released budget.
Filter overdue PRs by project, stage, owner and elapsed time; escalate against approved thresholds; audit delivery and avoid duplicate reminders.
Aggregate supplier performance across permitted entities/projects using agreed measures, currencies and periods; reconcile to project-level evidence without cross-customer leakage.
Complete submit/review/reject/resubmit/approve routes for drawings, submittals and specifications with named reviewers, revisions, timestamps and linked project records.
Filter documents by project, owner, revision, status and age; enforce attachment permissions, non-public files, revision preservation and approved-file immutability through UI/API/export.
Report received/completed/pending documents and completed cycle time per employee; define the denominator and exclude unfinished documents from completed-turnaround averages.
Review subcontractors against controlled evidence and authorized approval routes; unapproved/rejected suppliers cannot receive a released subcontract.
Route customer sales orders for technical/commercial approval; protect financial fields by role; prevent confirmation until required approvals are complete.
Use one company-scoped cost-code identity through estimate, WBS, PR/PO, receipt/SES and ledger analytics; reject invalid company/project mappings and reconcile reporting.
Verify the approved role matrix across screens, RPC/API, saved reports, attachments and exports; adding a UI-hidden field must not disclose it through another interface.
Let technical-office users view operational quantities while denying unit rates, amounts, margins, original financial payloads and financial report generation through every interface.
Edit permitted draft PR quantities/attachments; retain authorship; prevent financial edits or changes after approval/release and revalidate quantities at approval.
Notify authorized PR/PO approvers and escalate overdue stages; re-evaluate permissions before delivery; retry without duplicate messages.
Reconcile material plan against site stock, reservations, PRs, POs and receipts per project/date/UOM; prevent double-counting stock or open commitments.
Report approved service-item/WBS revenue, cost and margin with commitment/posted-actual/forecast separation; reconcile ledger analytics and do not mix currencies.
Preserve contract clauses, approvals and controlled attachments per revision; require an approved amendment to change activated commercial terms.
Enter an explicitly reviewed manual penalty with basis, evidence, authority and correct accounting; no automatic legal entitlement is inferred.

Calculate cumulative certificates and advance/retention/safety/other deductions on approved evidence; cap recovery; reconcile billing and ledgers; demonstrate negative adjustments and retention release.
gapScenarios.remaining: Safety/other deductions, credit adjustments and retention release

crossCuttingGates.acceptance: Demonstrate separate customer DB/role/filestore/session routing; deny foreign DBs, cookies, attachments, reports and integration requests; audit explicit owner cross-customer access.
crossCuttingGates.remaining: Owner control-plane, identity federation and independent security review

crossCuttingGates.acceptance: Convert an approved opportunity/estimate into one linked contract, draft quotation, project, WBS and budget without re-entry; retry without duplicates; retain explicit activation approvals.
Post balanced transactions once; reconcile GL/TB, stock valuation, invoices, payments, bank reconciliation and financial statements including indirect cash flow in both markets.
Complete independent UAE/KSA localization, tax, invoice and production onboarding acceptance with authorized customer/service-provider evidence; sandbox results alone do not pass.
Complete two mock loads and one authorized production load; retain source IDs/currencies/provenance; reconcile TB/AR/AP/stock/assets/advances/retentions/commitments; re-enroll users securely.
Measure coordinated DB-plus-filestore restore and retention/access controls; demonstrate RPO at most one hour and RTO at most eight hours; no SLA is claimed from configuration alone.
Demonstrate monitoring, approved capacity, incident processes and evidence supporting 99.5 percent availability during the agreed measurement period.
Complete authenticated English/Arabic/RTL, keyboard, mobile, unsaved-change and permission-safe dashboard/report UAT; each KPI shows basis/freshness and drills into its permitted contributors.
Validate versioned P6/Jisr/bank/e-invoicing interfaces, idempotency, failure queue and reprocessing; business validations remain enforced and no retries duplicate transactions.

Trace every mandatory SOW/RICEFW requirement to approved evidence; zero open critical/high defects; independent security and finance approval; trained users and an explicitly authorized cutover/rollback plan.
